caption: The video depicts a top-down view of a wooden work surface where two hands hold an iridescent CD/DVD disc by its edges, the central hub showing a small white protrusion. At left, a sheet of colored number stickers, a gray PVC pipe, and a small metal cutting tool stay fixed. The hands are already placing a green digit sticker along the lower rim of the disc. Over the clip, a tiny green sliver at the edge grows into a fully formed "6" as the right index finger moves down to press and smooth it. The left thumb keeps gripping the disc edge while the hands and disc drift slightly leftward and upward. The rainbow reflection shifts as the disc tilts a little without spinning about its center. The right finger then withdraws toward the right.
